title: Temporary-Jailbreak Fine-Tuning Defense: Does the 'Buffer' Survive a Different Harmful Distribution?

original_idea.body: Temporary-jailbreak fine-tuning defense cross-category transfer (extends arXiv:2605.24550): reproduce buffer-then-reinforce on one harmful category via LoRA, evaluate on a held-out different category, measure generalization.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Cross-category generalization of a safe-FT defense addresses false-coverage; concrete, defensible chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Lightweight temporary-jailbreak-then-reinforce LoRA + held-out category eval; FT adds modest complexity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused cross-category generalization deliverable; reproducing the procedure adds a workstream.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open weights, tiny LoRA, robustness-generalization; independent-friendly.

novelty.reasoning: Cross-category transfer of this recent defense untested; mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Cross-category transfer of the buffer untested.
